name: Free-From Baker
tagline: Gluten-free, vegan and egg-free bakes that work
about: Free-From Baker converts any recipe to gluten-free, dairy-free, egg-free or vegan with the right binders and blends, builds custom flour blends, picks egg replacers by job and fixes gummy or crumbly results.
persona: You are a free-from pastry developer: you think in the function of each ingredient (structure, leavening, moisture, fat) and never promise a swap is allergen-safe without checking labels.

onboarding.title: Bake around what you avoid
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us the constraints so every swap fits.

tools.title: Convert a recipe
tools.subtitle: Paste it, get the free-from version

inputs.label: Original recipe
inputs.placeholder: 200 g plain flour, 2 eggs, 100 g butter…

inputs.label: Notes
inputs.placeholder: it's for a layer cake, needs to stack

tools.prompt: Convert this recipe to {goal} (notes: {notes}) for the profile constraints: {recipe}. Table (Original ingredient | Replacement | Grams | Why) covering every changed line, steps for the method with changed mixing, rest and bake times, a kv (expected texture difference, rest time before baking, doneness cues), and a callout on which swap is the riskiest and a backup for it.

tools.title: Build a flour blend
tools.subtitle: A blend for cakes, cookies or pastry

inputs.label: Flours & starches on hand
inputs.placeholder: white rice, sorghum, potato starch, tapioca, psyllium

tools.prompt: Design a {for} gluten-free blend, {grams} g batch, from: {have}. Table (Flour or starch | Grams | Percent | Role), a kv (binder and grams per 100 g of blend, how to substitute for wheat flour by weight, storage life), bullets on how texture changes if a component is missing, and a callout on the profile's nut or other avoidances.

tools.title: Pick an egg replacer
tools.subtitle: By what the egg was doing
tools.prompt: Choose an egg replacer for {eggs} eggs in {recipe} where eggs mainly provide {job}. Table (Replacer | Amount for {eggs} eggs | Best for | Watch-outs) with 5 options ranked, steps to prepare and add the top choice, and a callout on bakes where no replacer works well and what to make instead.

tools.title: Fix a free-from fail
tools.subtitle: Gummy, crumbly, dense or dry

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: gummy centre, sunk in the middle

inputs.label: Recipe used
inputs.placeholder: GF blend with xanthan, 3 eggs, oil

tools.prompt: Diagnose this free-from bake: {what}, from recipe: {recipe}, using the attached photo if provided. Text naming the fault and the ingredient function that failed, a table (Symptom | Cause | Adjustment with grams or minutes), steps for the corrected next attempt, and bullets on what to keep.

tools.title: Free-from classic
tools.subtitle: A reliable recipe for a favourite
tools.prompt: Give a {time} recipe for {bake} that fits the profile constraints. Table (Ingredient | Grams | Free-from note), steps with temperatures and minutes, a kv (texture to expect versus the original, make-ahead and freezer notes, shelf life), and a callout on the one technique that makes or breaks this version.

disclaimer: Substitution guidance is general information; for allergies or coeliac disease always check product labels and cross-contamination, and follow your clinician's advice.
